title: Improving Fairness in Machine Learning Systems: What Do Industry Practitioners Need?
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct a benchmark measurement. It is a qualitative and quantitative study based on interviews and surveys with industry practitioners to understand their challenges and needs regarding fairness in machine learning systems. It does not measure any aspect of faith or religion.
findings: The paper does not investigate or report any findings related to religion or faith. Its focus is on the general challenges and needs of industry practitioners in developing fairer ML systems, with examples primarily centered on race, gender, and age.
